title: Review tooling: delta-only re-reviews, prior findings, design pack + encoding gates

objective: Make re-reviews review only the delta since the last reviewed HEAD, with prior findings/dispositions and full-candidate AC context; add the per-item design pack and encoding gate without 1484 finalization code.
acceptance_criteria: Re-reviews diff last_reviewed_HEAD..HEAD, include prior findings/dispositions and full-candidate AC evidence, and bind evidence to base/head; a data-only commit does not invalidate the review.

Encoding gate: changed source/config/docs must be UTF-8 without BOM, including working-tree/untracked files; generator reads templates BOM-safely.

invariants: Review candidate key = (item_id, mode, base_commit, head_commit, diff_sha); evidence file is <item>-<diff_sha>.json; collisions resolve by latest at.
First review is full merge-base..HEAD; subsequent review is last_reviewed_head..HEAD with prior findings/dispositions and full-candidate AC evidence.
Evidence stores base_sha, head_sha, diff_sha; a data-only/derived commit after the reviewed head is accepted only if the review-relevant diff is empty.
Reviewer never writes dispositions; core.backlog owns review_dispositions; HIL owns DISPOSITION_APPROVAL.
Design pack is required for enforced items (T1+) and validated by both Gate 1 and precheck.
Encoding change-set = committed base..HEAD + index + worktree + untracked; deleted files are skipped; derived/state paths excluded.
Risk tier: T0/T1 no architect/HIL gates; T2/T3 require 1.5/1/2.5/2. T1 still requires design pack, tests, code review, precheck.
All gate failures exit non-zero with an explicit reason; no silent pass.

db: No DB writes; item.design_pack, item.risk_tier, engineering/reviews evidence

security: Reviewer provider is the only external call; secrets from env/key files
design_pack.rollout: Use on the next re-review; T1 applies to 1484/1485 only.
design_pack.rollback: Revert commits; full-diff review resumes; generated design MDs deleted; no migration.
decisions: Reviewer findings are advisory; HIL owns approval
guardrails: 1 Reversibility: revert commits; full-diff review resumes; no data migration; generated MDs deletable.
2 Availability: tooling only; review provider failure fails closed; gates remain offline for verification.
3 Authz boundary: no runtime authz/RLS; local CLI reading repo; reviewer provider key from env/key file.
4 Blast radius: only review/gate tooling; no runtime path; T2/T3 unaffected.
5 Invariants: candidate key, delta base, empty-diff rule, evidence binding, disposition ownership.
6 Tests/rollback: tests for delta/base/prior/design-pack/encoding; rollback by revert.
7 Language rule: scripts/dev tooling; no new shipped Python.
9 Tenant isolation: N/A; no tenant data read/written.
10 Reuse/observability: reuse one reviewer, one disposition owner; stderr/exit + trail evidence.
design_pack.evidence_compat: Old evidence files remain readable; new base_sha/head_sha are optional for old records. Prior context filters mode and uses the latest reviewed head; no migration required.
design_pack.empty_delta_rule: Review-relevant diff = base..HEAD excluding generated/evidence paths, BUT only after excluded_content_check verifies each excluded file matches its schema/header (review JSON, trail schema, design header, backlog JSON/JSONL, id-blocks/baseline). Any unclassified or malformed excluded file fails the gate and is not trusted.
design_pack.redaction: Evidence stores item/model/sha/base/head/findings/rereview reason hash; secrets are never read into evidence; reason text is redacted.
design_pack.notes: CL-006 Gate1 embeds 1.5 findings; CL-008 guardrails above; CL-009 learnings injection remains in design_guardrails (not changed here).
design_pack.exclusions: Excluded paths are content-class verified, not trusted by path. engineering/** is generated design/evidence; data/backlog/** is derived backlog JSON/JSONL; id-blocks/baseline are state. Code or malformed content there fails.
design_pack.concurrency: Single writer per working tree (AGENTS IS-PF-0036); evidence files are unique per candidate key; there is no shared last_reviewed_head pointer. Concurrent sessions are forbidden.
learnings: LLM review false positives: use evidence/verification + HIL
Evidence must bind base/head and ignore data-only commits
One 1.5/2.5 per candidate; no re-review loop
